schemes.name: Gujarat Startup Policy 2022-27
schemes.description: Comprehensive policy to promote startups in Gujarat with seed funding up to Rs. 30 lakh, mentorship, incubation support, and tax incentives for DPIIT-recognized startups
schemes.ministry: Industries & Mines Department, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: DPIIT recognized startups registered in Gujarat with at least one founder residing in Gujarat

schemes.name: Gujarat Industrial Policy 2020
schemes.description: Capital subsidy up to 25% on fixed capital investment, stamp duty exemption, SGST reimbursement, and interest subsidy for new and existing industrial units in Gujarat
schemes.ministry: Industries & Mines Department, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: Industrial units setting up new projects or expanding existing units in Gujarat with minimum investment of Rs. 10 crore

schemes.name: MSME Policy Gujarat
schemes.description: Interest subsidy of 5-7% on term loans for micro, small, and medium enterprises, credit guarantee support, and technology upgradation assistance
schemes.ministry: Industries & Mines Department, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: MSMEs registered under MSMED Act 2006 with Udyam registration certificate operating in Gujarat

schemes.name: Gujarat Venture Finance Program
schemes.description: GVCF-managed venture capital fund providing seed and early-stage equity funding to technology-driven startups in Gujarat
schemes.ministry: Gujarat Venture Finance Corporation (GVFC)
schemes.eligibility: Technology startups with innovative products/services, minimum 51% ownership by Gujarat-based founders

schemes.name: Gujarat Biotechnology Policy 2022-27
schemes.description: Establishment of biotechnology parks, infrastructure support, research grants, and fiscal incentives for biotech startups and companies in Gujarat
schemes.ministry: Department of Science & Technology, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: Biotech startups and companies engaged in biotech research, manufacturing, or services registered in Gujarat

schemes.name: Gujarat IT/ITeS Policy 2022-27
schemes.description: Dedicated IT parks, co-working spaces, stamp duty exemption, electricity duty exemption, and special incentives for IT and ITeS companies in Gujarat
schemes.ministry: Department of Information Technology, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: IT/ITeS companies and startups providing software, BPO, KPO, or digital services registered in Gujarat

schemes.name: Gujarat Textile Policy 2022-27
schemes.description: Textile parks with plug-and-play infrastructure, capital subsidy, interest subsidy, and SGST reimbursement for textile manufacturing and processing units
schemes.ministry: Industries & Mines Department, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: Textile manufacturing, processing, and garment units setting up in Gujarat's textile parks or designated clusters

schemes.name: Gujarat Solar Park Policy
schemes.description: Land allocation, transmission infrastructure, and fiscal incentives for solar energy developers and renewable energy startups in Gujarat
schemes.ministry: Energy & Petrochemicals Department, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: Solar and renewable energy developers, EPC companies, and clean energy startups with projects in Gujarat

schemes.name: Gujarat Agro Food Park Policy
schemes.description: Food processing clusters with shared infrastructure, cold chain support, capital subsidy, and market linkage assistance for agro-food startups
schemes.ministry: Industries & Mines Department, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: Food processing units and agro-based startups operating in Gujarat with minimum investment of Rs. 50 lakh

schemes.name: Gujarat Pharma Policy
schemes.description: Pharmaceutical cluster development, common testing laboratory, R&D incentives, and marketing support for pharma and healthcare startups in Gujarat
schemes.ministry: Industries & Mines Department, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: Pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, and healthcare device startups with operations in Gujarat

schemes.name: Gujarat Tourism Policy 2022-27
schemes.description: Incentives for tourism-related ventures including heritage hotels, adventure tourism, eco-tourism, and homestays with capital subsidy and stamp duty exemption
schemes.ministry: Tourism Department, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: Tourism startups and hospitality ventures including homestays, heritage hotels, and adventure tourism operators in Gujarat

schemes.name: Gujarat Education Policy - EdTech Incentives
schemes.description: Support for EdTech startups through incubation, seed funding, government school partnerships, and digital learning platform development grants
schemes.ministry: Education Department, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: EdTech startups providing digital learning solutions for K-12, higher education, or skill development registered in Gujarat

schemes.name: Gujarat Green Technology Policy
schemes.description: Incentives for clean technology startups including waste management, water treatment, pollution control, and circular economy ventures
schemes.ministry: Environment & Forest Department, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: Clean tech and green technology startups with solutions for waste management, water treatment, or environmental conservation in Gujarat

schemes.name: Gujarat Drone Policy 2022-27
schemes.description: Drone corridor establishment, testing facility access, pilot training support, and regulatory facilitation for UAV and drone technology startups
schemes.ministry: Industries & Mines Department, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: Drone/UAV startups, manufacturers, and operators with DGCA approval operating in Gujarat

schemes.name: Gujarat Electric Vehicle Policy 2022-27
schemes.description: Purchase subsidies for EVs, charging infrastructure development support, manufacturing incentives, and R&D grants for electric vehicle ecosystem startups
schemes.ministry: Industries & Mines Department, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: EV manufacturers, component makers, charging infrastructure providers, and mobility startups registered in Gujarat

schemes.name: Gujarat MSME Competitive Capital Subsidy (PLI Scheme)
schemes.description: Production-linked incentive for MSMEs achieving competitive performance in manufacturing, with capital subsidy linked to incremental production output
schemes.ministry: Industries & Mines Department, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: MSMEs with minimum 2 years of operation in Gujarat achieving year-on-year production growth of 10% or more

schemes.name: Gujarat SC/ST Startup Scheme
schemes.description: Special seed funding up to Rs. 50 lakh, mentorship, and incubation support for SC/ST entrepreneurs to promote inclusive startup ecosystem in Gujarat
schemes.ministry: Social Justice & Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: SC/ST entrepreneurs with DPIIT-registered startups, minimum 51% ownership by SC/ST founder, resident of Gujarat

schemes.name: Gujarat Women Entrepreneurship Scheme
schemes.description: Dedicated support for women-led startups including subsidized co-working, seed funding up to Rs. 25 lakh, and women-focused incubation programs
schemes.ministry: Women & Child Development Department, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: Women entrepreneurs with at least 51% ownership in DPIIT-registered startups based in Gujarat

schemes.name: Gujarat Youth Startup Scheme
schemes.description: Support for entrepreneurs under 30 years with seed funding up to Rs. 20 lakh, free co-working space, and mentorship through dedicated youth startup cells
schemes.ministry: Youth Affairs & Sports Department, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: Entrepreneurs aged below 30 years with DPIIT-registered startups, resident of Gujarat

schemes.name: Gujarat Tribal Startup Scheme
schemes.description: Startup support for entrepreneurs from tribal districts of Gujarat including seed funding, skill development, and market access for tribal enterprise development
schemes.ministry: Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: Tribal entrepreneurs from designated tribal districts of Gujarat with startup ideas or early-stage ventures

schemes.name: Gujarat Film Policy 2022-27
schemes.description: Incentives for film production, post-production facilities, film city infrastructure, and entertainment technology startups including single-window clearance
schemes.ministry: Industries & Mines Department, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: Film production houses, post-production studios, VFX companies, and entertainment tech startups operating in Gujarat

schemes.name: Gujarat Sports Policy 2023-28
schemes.description: Support for sports technology startups, sports equipment manufacturing, fitness tech ventures, and sports infrastructure development with fiscal incentives
schemes.ministry: Youth Affairs & Sports Department, Government of Gujarat
schemes.eligibility: Sports tech startups, fitness equipment manufacturers, and sports infrastructure developers registered in Gujarat
